name: finqa_bench_stealth-finance-v3
description: finqa_bench_stealth-finance-v3 measures a model's ability to perform numerical reasoning and extract quantitative answers from financial texts (e.g., reports, tables, disclosures). It focuses on multi-step arithmetic, evidence extraction from document passages, and producing exact numeric answers or reasoning chains. Tasks typically require interpreting tabular/paragraph financial content and performing correct calculations.
reputation: A domain-specific variant in the FinQA family used by researchers and practitioners evaluating financial numeric reasoning; has moderate adoption in finance-focused NLP evaluations.
